title: Rust Breaker
body:
"Crushes through rusty armor like a goblin through a picnic."

The Rust Breaker is a large metal mace that can be bought in the Goblin Town Shops in the Acidlands once the Arena has been defeated, it's a large melee weapon that does decent damage and knockback but has a high cooldown. it can be effective at dealing with hordes of enemies due to its large size
